default.next_step: Ask a Department caseworker at one of the four district offices for an official interpretation.

eligibility.next_step: Ask a Department caseworker or supervisor to review the eligibility question and the missing case facts.

appeals.next_step: Ask the Department about review or the Calder County Assistance Appeals Panel about an appeal.

conflict.next_step: Escalate the conflicting provisions to a Department supervisor or other designated policy authority before acting.
